summary: Tested new phone field in contact form. Frontend fully passes (phone input present between email and details, validation toast on empty phone, success toast on full submit, form clears, no console errors). Backend FAILS phone requirements: ContactMessageCreate model in server.py does not include a 'phone' field, so phone is neither validated (min/max/required) nor persisted (stored as empty string).

critical.issue: ContactMessageCreate is missing the 'phone' field. Payloads without phone (or with phone < 5 chars) return 200 instead of 422. When phone IS sent, it is silently dropped (input.model_dump() has no phone) so ContactMessage.phone defaults to '' — the value never reaches MongoDB or the Resend email. GET /api/contact returns phone='' for freshly created records even when submitted with a phone.

action_items: Add phone field to ContactMessageCreate in /app/backend/server.py: `phone: str = Field(min_length=5, max_length=20)` so it becomes required with proper length validation. This alone will fix all three failing backend tests (persistence, missing-phone 422, short-phone 422) since ContactMessage already accepts phone and the email template already renders it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ContactMessageCreate does not match the stated contract — phone is missing. This causes silent data loss (frontend sends phone; backend drops it).

server.py: logger is defined AFTER resend.api_key assignment and send_lead_notification (which uses logger). Works only because send_lead_notification is called later, but is fragile — move logging.basicConfig / logger to top.
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_-prefixed contact records inserted during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds `phone: str = Field(min_length=5, max_length=20)` to ContactMessageCreate, rerun /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — all 6 tests should pass. Frontend already fully works.
rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/backend/server.py ContactMessageCreate Pydantic model only defines name/email/details. FastAPI validates incoming JSON against this model, so the 'phone' key sent by the frontend is not present in input.model_dump(), and ContactMessage(**input.model_dump()) falls back to phone='' default. Fix: add phone field with min_length=5, max_length=20 to ContactMessageCreate.
